tip: Modals stay the same in the tag

explanation: Positive present simple (3rd person) → negative tag with 'does'. 'lives' → 'doesn't she'.
tip: Present simple uses do/does in the tag

explanation: Negative 'won't' → positive tag 'will they'.

explanation: Positive past perfect 'had' → negative tag 'hadn't he'.

explanation: Negative 'don't' → positive tag 'do you'.

tip: Words like nobody/nothing/never make the statement negative
